# Document Integrity Checklist: Heading Cross-Reference Palette (MVP)

**Purpose**: Review whether the requirements for what the add-in writes into documents (bookmarks, fields, literal text, undo, failure handling, tracked changes) are complete, clear, consistent and measurable before tasks are generated.
**Created**: 2026-10-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [contracts/document-gateway.md](../contracts/document-gateway.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Depth**: Standard, pre-implementation · **Audience**: author and reviewer before `/speckit-tasks` · **Scope**: spec checked against plan, research and contracts

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does the spec define which existing bookmarks count as being "on the heading" for reuse (exact text span, whole paragraph, partial overlap)? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, Research R6]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the spec say whether Word-managed bookmarks that Word itself may delete or recreate (for example table-of-contents `_Toc…` bookmarks, `_GoBack`) are eligible for reuse? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the rule for choosing among several usable existing bookmarks stated in the spec, or only in research? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Research R6]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for the formatting of an inserted reference: whether it takes the formatting at the insertion point or the heading's formatting? [Gap, Research R5]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the bookmark's extent specified (heading text only, excluding the paragraph mark) so that text references never carry a paragraph break or heading style? [Gap, Spec §FR-012, Research R6]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the spec define what "number" means in references: Word's full-context number (e.g. "4.3") rather than the level's own number ("3") or relative numbering? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Constitution III]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements stated for an empty heading (no text): whether it is listed, how a bookmark is placed, and what a text reference displays? [Gap, Data Model §Heading]
- [ ] CHK008 Does the spec state where FR-013's undo exceptions and the co-authoring findings must be documented (user documentation, release notes, plan)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Does FR-009's "hyperlinked cross-reference fields" explicitly cover page-number fields as well as heading-reference fields, matching the "page" format? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "stable across edits" in FR-012 bounded by a list of edits that must not change the bookmark (rename, renumber, move, restyle) and edits that legitimately may (deleting the heading)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "fails cleanly" for co-authored documents defined in observable terms (document unchanged, message shown)? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "protected document" defined, including whether "allow only tracked changes" protection permits insertion as a tracked change? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases, Research R8]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "the reference replaces the selection" specified for selections that span several paragraphs, or contain fields, bookmarks or tables? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Is the plan's "usable bookmark" restriction (research R6) consistent with FR-011's unconditional "MUST be reused", or does the spec need amending to allow a new bookmark when the existing one is unsuitable? [Conflict, Spec §FR-011, Research R6]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the field switches in research R5 consistent with the constitution's format mechanics (`\w` number, plain text, `\p` above/below, `\h` on every field)? [Consistency, Research R5, Constitution III]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the OOXML fallback required to produce the same field codes and bookmark layout as the primary path, so output does not depend on which path ran? [Consistency, Research R5, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK017 Do the spec's "first phase" assumption (fallbacks are equivalent) and the plan's conditional default shortcut agree on which spike outcomes require a spec change? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Research R4]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the contract's failure reasons (`staleTarget`, `protected`, `locationChanged`, `hostError`) each traceable to a spec requirement or edge case? [Traceability, Contracts §document-gateway, Spec §FR-024]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Is "correct, current value" in SC-004 defined against an objective reference (for example the result Word's own cross-reference of the same kind would show)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK020 Is SC-005's scenario (reorder, rename, update) specific about which edits are included, such as moving headings between levels or across sections? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK021 Can SC-007 ("without the add-in") be checked objectively: which Word versions or platforms count, and is opening in other applications in or out of scope? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK022 Is SC-009 measurable given that the spec allows undocumented-in-advance exceptions — is there a target such as "single undo in all tested cases on the supported build"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK023 Is FR-014's "document left unchanged" verifiable, with "unchanged" defined (no new bookmark, field, text or revision mark)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-014]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for the insertion point becoming invalid while the palette is open (the user or a co-author edits text at the cursor)? [Gap, Contracts §document-gateway `locationChanged`]
- [ ] CHK025 Does FR-003 say whether headings outside the main text (in text boxes, footnotes, table cells, headers) are listed as targets? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for headings that are themselves tracked insertions or tracked deletions: are they listed, and what happens to references if the change is rejected or accepted? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the outcome of rejecting a tracked insertion of a reference specified, including whether a bookmark created for it may remain? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements stated for headings whose text contains fields (including other cross-references), so a text reference to them does not nest or loop? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 Is the expected display for references whose target heading is later deleted stated as accepted behaviour for this phase (Word's own error text), given that validation is out of scope? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK030 Are "above/below" and "page" behaviours specified for references placed in footnotes or endnotes? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-001a, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the bookmark name collision rule specified against all existing names, hidden ones included, case-insensitively? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Research R6]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK032 Is the assumption that a single document transaction yields one Undo step recorded as unverified, with the spike that resolves it named? [Assumption, Research R5, Plan §Delivery sequence]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the minimum supported Word build stated consistently between spec assumptions ("current channel") and plan (2408+, 2508+ for the full API)? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the dependency on Word's own numbering (references show whatever Word numbers) reconciled with the palette's displayed number possibly being composed by the add-in? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Research R7]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Highest-risk items: CHK002 (reusing table-of-contents bookmarks that Word regenerates could break references), CHK014 (spec/research conflict on reuse), CHK004/CHK005 (reference formatting and bookmark extent)
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
